protocol.purpose: full-loader two-seed conditional-core update calibration and seven-family paired quality confirmation including the FFN capacity control
protocol.calibration_metric: arithmetic mean highest-FP32 fixed-input adapter-delta update RMS across 6 blocks, steps 50/100/250/500 and seeds 53/54
protocol.selection: closest absolute log(mean update / target); excludes loss/validation/FID/class agreement
protocol.correction: clip(previous multiplier * target / previous mean update, 1/16, 16)

auxiliary_classifier.purpose: fixed auxiliary evaluator of generated requested-class agreement
auxiliary_classifier.retention: one frozen evaluator and its compact training records until explicitly removed

protocol.ema: in-memory .999; existing evaluators reused, no new model/evaluator weights
protocol.retention: compact source/configs/splits/metrics/logs/reports and one 100-image grid per confirmation until explicitly removed
limits: Scalar aggregate update matching does not match each seed/block/time or live branch magnitude.
Confirmation seeds 55/56/57 are independent of calibration 53/54 and previous screens; one fixed held-out split.
FFN capacity differs from basis r2 by 384 parameters, but its shape change also changes base initialization; seed-matched only.
Equal-shape variants have identical base initialization; raw/scaled r8 share adapter initialization.
Rates are selected on function updates; controls keep multiplier 1; no quality-rate optimization.
Three seeds and sample SD are not confidence intervals; finite 5k FID and one sampling seed.
Concurrent eager throughput is not an isolated speed comparison; equal steps are not equal wall-clock.
Common non-affine norms/AdaLN-Zero; normalized adapter input; broadcast class/time only; no sequence-context retrieval or cross-attention.
Gains and identity initialization are empirical choices, not variance preservation or a muP derivation.

limitations: One fixed validation split; seed spread is not a confidence interval or test-set estimate.
FID uses held-out train images and finite sample counts; not published 50k-image FID.
Wrong-class loss measures sensitivity/use, not generated class accuracy.
External condition is a single class/time vector; sequence-conditioned cross-attention is not evaluated.
Concurrent throughput shares CPU/storage; matrix FLOPs omit non-matmul work and backward.
Generative evaluation time includes sampling and FID feature/statistic computation; isolated inference throughput is not measured.
Each screen has its own declared LR/initialization recipe; optimal rates are not established without bracketing.

limits: Scalar aggregate update matching does not match each seed/block/time or live branch magnitude.
Confirmation seeds 55/56/57 are independent of calibration 53/54 and previous screens; one fixed held-out split.
FFN capacity differs from basis r2 by 384 parameters, but its shape change also changes base initialization; seed-matched only.
Equal-shape variants have identical base initialization; raw/scaled r8 share adapter initialization.
Rates are selected on function updates; controls keep multiplier 1; no quality-rate optimization.
Three seeds and sample SD are not confidence intervals; finite 5k FID and one sampling seed.
Concurrent eager throughput is not an isolated speed comparison; equal steps are not equal wall-clock.
Common non-affine norms/AdaLN-Zero; normalized adapter input; broadcast class/time only; no sequence-context retrieval or cross-attention.
Gains and identity initialization are empirical choices, not variance preservation or a muP derivation.
